shipLog.text: ◆ The wheat has reached the height specified in the manual. It did this without ambition. The manual respects that.
◆ Crop planted! ARIA considers this the true beginning of the mission! She is not wrong but she is loud about it!
Arrived at Nebula 1! The leg cost −5 FUEL, −4 FOOD, −2 H2O, −1 O2, 6 DAYS. Lovely view!
Departure Protocol: we chose “Check the crop one last time before departure”. Love that for us!
The crop is fine. +2 MORALE, 1 DAY. A win, statistically!
◆ A NEBULA! The sensors are completely blind! ARIA has decided this makes everything a surprise!
Arrived at Soil Sample Paradise! The leg cost −5 FUEL, −5 FOOD, −2 H2O, −1 O2, 7 DAYS. Lovely view!
◆ Soil sampler survey logged (1/3). The colony office will want this.
Soil Sample Paradise: we chose “Survey for water sources”. Love that for us!
Subsurface ice detected and extracted. +5 H2O, 2 DAYS. A win, statistically!
◆ Planetary approach! ARIA estimates the surface is 70% wonderful! She did not measure the other 30%!
▶ TRADER SHIP ON APPROACH
Arrived at The Refueling Opportunity! The leg cost −5 FUEL, −4 FOOD, −2 H2O, −1 O2, 6 DAYS. Lovely view!
Uninvited Gardeners: we chose “Botanist counter-infestation protocol”. Love that for us!
The botanist deploys an integrated response — traps at the vents… +2 MORALE, 2 DAYS. A win, statistically!
Market Row: we chose “BACK TO DOCK”. Love that for us!
−1 FOOD, 1 DAY. Still a win!
Station Inbound: we chose “LEAVE STATION”. Love that for us!
Nothing aboard changed. A win, statistically!
◆ The station captain pings the comms once on your way out: “Safe burns out there, captain. The ring'll still be here next pass.”
◆ Still thinking about launch day! Every system was perfect and the paperwork was barely any paperwork at all!
The Wheat hit VEGETATIVE! 27% grown, health 90. Thriving!
Arrived at The Belated Concern! The leg cost −5 FUEL, −5 FOOD, −2 H2O, −1 O2, 7 DAYS. Lovely view!
◆ MARV files a note on what looking back at everything from far away does to crews. The effect has a name.
The Middle: we chose “Mark it — small ceremony, real juice”. Love that for us!
The crew assembles at the viewport for the equator crossing. +5 MORALE, 1 DAY. A win, statistically!
◆ Derelict ahead! ARIA calls it a pre-owned vessel! The previous owners left everything behind, which ARIA considers very generous!
◆ GROWBAY ALERT — pest outbreak detected. TREAT from the growbay before it compounds.
▶ TRADER SHIP ON APPROACH
◆ GROWBAY — pest outbreak treated.
Arrived at New Somewhere! The leg cost −5 FUEL, −4 FOOD, −2 H2O, −1 O2, 6 DAYS. Lovely view!
◆ Soil sampler survey logged (2/3). The colony office will want this.
Vessel Approaching: we chose “Fight — bring weapons online”. Love that for us!
Vessel Approaching: we WON! −11 HULL, +1 FUEL CELL, +7 MORALE, +7 GOLD, 4 DAYS. Teamwork!
◆ ARIA did a full systems check and everything PASSED! She rang a little chime! That was the chime! From earlier!
Arrived at Terminal Ambivalence! The leg cost −5 FUEL, −5 FOOD, −2 H2O, −1 O2, 7 DAYS. Lovely view!
After Action: we chose “Stand the crew down — mandatory rest”. Love that for us!
You order everyone off shift, and take the con yourself so the order… +6 MORALE, 2 DAYS. A win, statistically!
Market Row: we chose “BACK TO DOCK”. Love that for us!
−1 FOOD, 1 DAY. Still a win!
Station Inbound: we chose “LEAVE STATION”. Love that for us!
Nothing aboard changed. A win, statistically!
◆ The station captain pings the comms once on your way out: “Safe burns out there, captain. The ring'll still be here next pass.”
◆ A station! People! Shops! Air someone else is paying to recycle! ARIA has never been so grateful for infrastructure!
The Wheat hit FLOWERING! 58% grown, health 94. Thriving!
◆ GROWBAY ALERT — pest outbreak detected. TREAT from the growbay before it compounds.
